newsitem.title: UK: Severn Trent to return cash to shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Severn Trent to return cash to shareholders.

text.p: British water and sewerage company Severn Trent Plc said on Monday that it plans to return 134 million stg to shareholders through a capital reorganisation.
Severn said that shareholders will receive one ordinary share of 62p nominal value and one B share of nominal value of 38p in exchange for every existing ordinary share of 100p held.
The company announced earlier this month that it planned to seek approval from shareholders to buy 4.4 percent of its shares after buying 5.6 percent in December.
The buyback of 10 percent of the company's shares follows its failure to buy South West Water last year when the move was blocked by the then Conservative conservative.
By 1309 GMT, shares in Severn Trent were 19-1/2p higher at 784p.
